name: Harley-Davidson Model W Sport Twin
engine: 584 cc side-valve flat twin, total-loss oil
intro: Harley's opposed-twin lightweight, very different from the V-twins. Rare and mostly in collections.

B: It runs a magneto. Check the points, the condenser and the slip ring before you blame the carb.
H: Check whether yours has a total-loss or a recirculating oil system before you fill it, and know which one you are running.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
